items.t: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Deepens AI Data Center Liquid Cooling Push
items.sum: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) announced a new partnership with Solenis focused on data center liquid cooling for AI workloads. The collaboration combines Vertiv's cooling systems and predictive maintenance tools with Solenis' fluid chemistry and monitoring expertise. items.t: Solenis and Vertiv Partner to Advance Liquid Cooling Management for AI Data Centers
items.sum: Solenis, a leading global provider of fluid and water management solutions, today announced a strategic partnership with Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, to help data center operators manage the performance and reliability of liquid cooling systems.
